Global Wrestling's biography card (accession 0159), bio 4406, is this record: The held row: 'Danielle Northsky won the CCWA North American Championship from Furious at Sensation with her own Spirit Way finisher, ranked #2 on the fed's own Top 5, and was still champion when the held record ends in March 2005', with the tenure's finisher field reading 'Spirit Way'. Add the full three-part name, and this is card-to-card on an invented finisher plus a named title. This row is also the receipt under bio 4282's CCWA question above.
